fields.description: Which part of a payroll slip this row is about. The six employee-side components (Gross Pay, Federal Tax, SS Employee, Medicare Employee, State Tax, Net Pay) are together the two sides of gross pay and are all required; the five employer-side ones are required only where the run has an amount for them.

fields.label: Debit Account
fields.description: Where the expense side goes. Required for Gross Pay (the wage expense) and for every employer-side component (the payroll tax expense). Left blank on a withholding component, which has no debit side.

fields.label: Credit Account
fields.description: Where the liability side goes. Required for every withheld amount, for Net Pay (a payroll clearing, bank or cash account) and for every employer-side component. Left blank on Gross Pay, which has no credit side.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Why this component points where it does. The place to record that the SUTA account is reconciled against the quarterly state return, or that Net Pay clears rather than paying.
